{{Quote|Score another one of the 'Queen of Sabacc'! Guess you just aren't having a good day, Thyte.''"<br>"''I'm not having a particularly good ''decade''.''"<br>"''Aw, stop being such a wet blanket. You think you're the only ex-Rebel who's had a setback?|[[Ranna Gorjaye]] and Darren Thyte|<ref name="TKO">''[[The Kathol Outback]]''</ref>}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] prior to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]], a '''battle''' was fought between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on [[Vaenrood]], an astronomical object<ref name="TDC" /> located in the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA-OC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Vaenrood system/Legends|Vaenrood system]]</ref> During the engagement, [[New Republic Army|New Republic ground forces]], supported by [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] air cover, attacked Imperial forces that included [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] units in a [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region.<ref name="TDC" />

During the engagement, an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Darryn Thyte]] was hit by artillery fire causing the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] to crash. While Thyte survived the crash, he lost the majority of his right [[Limb/Legends|arm]] when the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] canopy buckled and snapped during the impact, shearing through the limb. [[Medic/Legends|Medics]] were able to replace his arm with the only clunky [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] prosthesis they had available. The injury forced Thyte to be taken off of active piloting duty. Several months later, Thyte joined [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|New Republic forces]] when they successfully freed Kal'Shebbol, the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="TDC" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Kathol sector]],<ref name="TEA-OC" /> from the rule of the Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]].<ref name="TDC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Vaenrood was indirectly mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s short story "[[The Saga Begins]]"<ref name="TSB">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> and further elaborated on in Darryn Thyte's character biography in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="TDC" />
